gaps.sentence: Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).

gaps.sentence: A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
The car broke ___ on the motorway.
It's time you faced up ___ your responsibilities.
gaps.explanation: face up TO something = accept and deal with something difficult.

gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.
